name: Best-of React Web
summary: Ranked list of 430 open-source React libraries and tools, scored automatically and grouped into 22 categories.
description: A curated list of React open-source projects ranked by a project-quality score computed from GitHub and package-manager metrics (stars, contributors, downloads, activity). The 430 projects are grouped into 22 categories such as UI frameworks, app frameworks, styling, tables and grids, input components, state management, routing, animations, data visualization, developer tools and testing, and the list is updated weekly from a projects.yaml file.
contains: 430 open-source projects with a combined 5M stars
22 categories from UI frameworks to testing and admin dashboards
project-quality score computed from GitHub and package-manager metrics
badges for new, inactive, dead and trending projects
